responsibility: This header defines the target-specific cost and decision state used by the lower-subreg RTL transformation. It describes which machine modes, zero-extensions, and doubleword shifts should be split for speed or size, records the chosen twice-word integer mode, and provides the switchable-target target_lower_subreg global through which lower-subreg.cc consults per-target profitability decisions.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/lower-subreg.cc, which runs the lower-subreg passes and rewrites RTL, this header defines the target decision structures and globals that describe which modes, zero-extends, and shifts should be split.
